Chapter One

a Brief histOry

Imperial Chemical Industries Ltd (ICI) was registered on 7 December 1926. Its formation was the biggest merger yet seen in British industry. It created an effective monopoly of the British chemical industry, and immediately ICI became a major player on the world stage.
How it came about, and how it progressed (and, sometimes, faltered)
